facts.fact: The Herald reports the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe oversees mobile money by directive: a 2021 directive enforced one line, one wallet, and the February 2026 Monetary Policy Statement directed operators to verify customers by 30 June 2026.

ZWE.note: KYC and fraud controls stated; no consumer conduct rule or complaints body.
No government payment to people stated.
No survey share of adults stated.

facts.fact: The Herald quotes the RBZ governor saying all mobile money operators' wallets were rescreened against the Civil Registry by 30 June 2026, and that mobile banking apps, mobile money platforms and QR payments are growing in use.

ZWE.note: No tax or fee payment stated.
